{"metadata":{"description":"Universal vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: attachments with native models, 40+ tools, PDF/OCR/diagrams.","id":"gh:1338166229","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-vision-bridge","slug":"GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-vision-bridge","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","multimodal","ocr","vision"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Universal vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: attachments with native models, 40+ tools, PDF/OCR/dia"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"sal vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: attachments with native models, 40+ tools, PDF/OCR/diagrams."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-vision-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Universal Vision Bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Seamless Multimodal Attachments with Text-Only Chat Mo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ersal Vision Bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Seamless Multimodal Attachments with Text-Only Chat Models"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🇬🇧 English •
🇷🇺 Русский •
🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"When interacting with text-only chat models (any provider/model that accepts text only) in **DeepSee"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"k Harness**, users cannot natively attach and send images:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"1. In **DSH 0.1.2-alpha.2+**, the core session controller performs a strict server-side modality che"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ck (`ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo`). If the active conversation model lacks `image` in `inputModalities`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":", the prompt is immediately rejected with a `session/attachment-invalid` error ("Model does not supp"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ort image input").
2. Standard text-only adapters throw errors when encountering raw multimodal imag"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"e blocks in their message payload."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### How `dsh-vision-bridge` Solves This"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`dsh-vision-bridge` acts as an intelligent intermediary inside the Cordis runtime:
* **Server-Side M"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"odality Bridge (v0.5.3+)**: Decorates `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` and `ctx.llm.listModels` so the ses"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"sion controller accepts image attachments on all models when bridging is active.
* **Automatic Image"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" Rewrite (`agent/pre-step` & `llm/stream`)**: Automatically intercepts image blocks, routes them to "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"a configured vision model (a catalog provider/model, or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint), receive"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"s a descriptive synthesis, and rewrites the image block into text context `[The user attached an ima"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ge. Description: ...]` before handing it to the text-only chat model.
* **Native Passthrough**: Auto"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"matically detects models that natively support vision and allows images to pass directly without unn"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ecessary rewriting.
* **Rich Visual Tool Suite**: Exposes ~40 specialized tools for on-demand OCR (i"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ncl. local Tesseract), visual question answering, bounding-box grounding, document/table/formula ext"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"raction, QR/barcode reading, UI-flow reconstruction, multi-model consensus and more. `vision_consens"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"us` is opt-in via the `consensusEnabled` setting."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 🏗️ Architecture"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## ✨ Key Features"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 1. Processing Modes
* **`hybrid` (default)**: Automatically describes attached images in chat tu"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rns while keeping all ~40 explicit vision tools available for follow-up reasoning.
* **`llm`**: Pure"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" auto-rewrite mode — images are transparently converted to text context; tools remain callable.
* **"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"`tools`**: Auto-rewrite disabled — the chat model is expected to explicitly invoke `describe_image` "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"or OCR tools when required."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 2. Multi-Channel Endpoint Routing & Fallback
Chain multiple vision backends with automatic failo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ver, parallel racing, and circuit breaker:
* `dsh-catalog`: Auto-detect or select any vision-capable"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" model already registered in DSH.
* `openai-compatible`: Standard OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" (vLLM, SGLang, OpenRouter, etc.).
* `ollama`: Auto-discovery and local inference through any vision"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"-capable model the local Ollama instance exposes.
* `webhook` / `custom`: External HTTP or JSON-RPC "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"e local Ollama instance exposes.
* `webhook` / `custom`: External HTTP or JSON-RPC vision endpoints."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 3. High-Performance LRU Description Cache
Caches vision responses by `hash(bytes + prompt + mode"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"l + mode)` to eliminate redundant vision API calls and save token quota on repeated questions about "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"liminate redundant vision API calls and save token quota on repeated questions about the same image."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 4. Comprehensive Visual Tool Inventory (~40 Tools)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Tool Category | Tools | Description |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **Core** | `describe_image`, `read_image`, `inspect_image` | General image analysis by attachment "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ID, file path, or URL. |
| **Geometry & Detection** | `vision_ground`, `vision_crop`, `vision_detect"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"`, `vision_compare`, `vision_present` | Bounding box coordinates (0–1000 scale), object inventory, m"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ulti-image comparison. |
| **OCR & Text** | `vision_ocr`, `vision_ocr_local`, `vision_long_ocr`, `vi"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"sion_trace`, `vision_colors`, `vision_extract_foreground` | Transcription, local Tesseract OCR (offl"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ine), long screenshot stitching, SVG tracing, color palettes. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 15. 🛡️ Enterprise Security & Settings Governance (`v0.5.27`)
* **Masked Secrets**: `GET /channel"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s` automatically masks sensitive provider API keys (`sk-p...7890` or `********`) and reports `hasApi"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"Key: true` to prevent secret leakage in browser DevTools/XHR. `POST /channels` preserves existing ke"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ys when a mask is submitted.
* **CSRF & Origin Guard**: All mutating and cost-incurring endpoints (`"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"/config`, `/channels`, `/upload-pdf`, `/test`, `/bench`, `/batch`, `DELETE /journal`, `DELETE /cache"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"`, and `/doctor?probe=1`) validate `sec-fetch-site !== 'cross-site'` via `isTrustedSettingsRequest`,"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" rejecting cross-origin attacks with `403 Forbidden`. The default `GET /doctor` report is static (no"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" channel probes).
* **SSRF fetch policy**: model-supplied image URLs are fetched only through `safeF"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"etch` — non-http(s) schemes, localhost names and private/loopback/link-local hosts (incl. IPv4-mappe"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"d IPv6 and NAT64) are refused on every redirect hop; response bodies are capped. Use `allowedUrlHost"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"s` to explicitly re-allow an internal endpoint.
* **apiKeyRef**: channels may reference a credential"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"-service entry or environment variable by NAME instead of storing a plaintext `apiKey` in settings; "},{"id":"p21s13","text":"keys resolve at call time. `GET /channels` keeps masking values; key preservation on save matches ch"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"annels by identity, not position.
* **Privacy & honesty**: `maskPII`, `stripEXIF`, `auditLog` and `c"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"onsensusEnabled` settings are wired end-to-end; the previously decorative face-blur / NSFW / tiling "},{"id":"p21s16","text":"toggles and no-op presets were removed.
* **Native settingsScope Integration**: Settings UI binds di"},{"id":"p21s17","text":"rectly to `ctx.settingsScope` (`namespace: 'dsh-vision-bridge'`), supporting reactive snapshot liste"},{"id":"p21s18","text":"ners and kernel state synchronization."}],"truncated":true}
